name: zanmato_pick
description: The auto-target mask of the player's Zanmato (command 0x30E2, the real command record's bytes) over 1 to 8 monsters with random groups (0 to 2), battle distance (0 to 3), Targetable and dead flags, then the action itself (calculator and hit applier): the legal members of the chosen group die, nobody else changes.

function.signature: u32 auto_target(int user, int cmdId, int side)

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts, animation requests and loot helpers hooked and recorded; the game is never run

notes: A stratified subset (every 5th) of the 1,500 vectors of research/re-ffx-zanmato-and-orders.md section 2 (seed 20261016, the same draw order).

`out.fate` is each monster's HP and dead flag before and after the action run on the mask (HP 0 and dead = killed); the command record's Cmd+0x1a and Cmd+0x1b are read from command.bin by the game's own lookup (0x78CE50).
